records.text: There is no famine in Gaza because videos show fat Palestinians.
records.speaker: Jonathan Conricus

appearances.snippet: spokesman, and out of nowhere he said, "There is no famine in Gaza. There are so many videos of fat Palestinians—fat." He emphasized "fat."

verification.notes: The original Piers Morgan debate prominently features Jonathan Conricus invoking the number of fat Gazans while disputing famine claims. This verifies the attributed quotation, not the underlying proposition that famine was absent.

sources.title: Do You Know How Many FAT Gazans I’ve Seen? Bassem Youssef vs Jonathan Conricus
sources.relevance: Original program recording verifies the quotation and its famine-debate context.

records.text: Jonathan Conricus formerly worked for Israel Defense Forces
